base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_031='Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_031='Physics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.XCL_042 = m.XCL_030
WHERE m.XCL_031 IN ('Finance','Physics');
